system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: At each of these three stages, the agent is paired with a concise domain-specific guideline that fixes the deliverable but not the research itself
system_prompt_style.note: The paper names no render mechanism. The prompt is inferred to be seed-plus-guideline per stage and domain. The attached repository is karpathy/autoresearch, not the ResearchArena harness, so it is not used for coding.

env_context_strategy.note: Off-the-shelf CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code) supply their own tools. The paper does not describe how context is given.

tool_call_format.note: Tool calling is delegated to the wrapped CLI agents.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: each agent receives a CS-domain seed and runs a four-stage research loop: ideation, experiments, paper writing, and review. Stages 1–3 each include a self-refinement loop.
loop_primitives.note: The four fixed stages are the default. generate_test_repair is the closest value for the per-stage self-refinement loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: During ideation, each agent is aware of the resources (i.e., hardware and time budget) to write an experimental plan based on the proposed ideas.
planning_granularity.note: A plan is written as a stage deliverable. The paper does not say whether it is stored as a structured object that is re-read across steps.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: a single off-the-shelf agent operates autonomously across broader computer science domains, rather than a pipeline of stage-specific components
multi_agent_topology.note: Three reviewer agents are used in the evaluation stage (PR). They are outside the research run.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: a single off-the-shelf agent operates autonomously across broader computer science domains, rather than a pipeline of stage-specific components

human_in_loop.note: Human meta-review happens after the run, as evaluation, not as gating.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Stages 1–3 each include a self-refinement loop.
self_verification.note: The SAR and PR reviews in Stage 4 are evaluation and are not fed back to the agent.

retry_policy.note: The 3 trials per agent-domain pair are independent experimental replicates, not retries.

timeouts.evidence_quote: each agent is aware of the resources (i.e., hardware and time budget)
timeouts.note: A time budget is mentioned. The paper does not say whether it is enforced.

filesystem_access.note: Read-only workspace access applies only to reviewer agents: "Each reviewer is givenread-onlyaccess to the workspace" (Sec. 3.4).

tracing.note: Logs are collected as artifacts. Their format is unspecified.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Stage 4 evaluates the resulting paper through three complementary lenses
eval_hooks.note: Evaluation is part of the pipeline per the paper. No repository was available to verify it.

target_domain.evidence_quote: lets general-purpose agents carry out the full research loop themselves: ideation, experimentation, paper writing, and self-refinement

open_source.note: The paper states a harness release ("the configurable harness"). No licence is given. The attached MIT repository is karpathy/autoresearch, which is a different system.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Claude Code using Opus 4.6, Codex using GPT-5.4, and Kimi Code using K2.5
model_agnostic.note: The harness wraps several vendors' agent CLIs.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: we release the full corpus: 117 papers with their code and logs, 351 PR reviews, 117 SAR scores, human inspection results, and the configurable harness.
primary_artifact.note: No ResearchArena repository appears in the evidence. The supplied repo (karpathy/autoresearch) is a related but separate system.

first_release_date.note: Fallback to the paper v1 date because no tag was available.

pinned_version.note: The evidence pin (karpathy/autoresearch 228791fb499a) is not the ResearchArena harness.

stars.note: The 96348 stars belong to karpathy/autoresearch, not ResearchArena.
